Federal government building construction.basis: Final clean of entire building ($0.15-0.40/sf, 180 sf/hr) plus ~10% for badging, access, closeout documentation and wage determinations

State and municipal government facility.basis: Final clean of entire building plus ~7% for public-agency documentation and local prevailing wage rules

Federal courthouse and administrative bu.basis: Final clean of entire building plus ~15% for daily security screening, millwork/stone detailing and escorted secure areas

Police, fire and emergency services faci.basis: Final clean of entire building plus ~12% for apparatus bay scrubbing, trench drains, decon rooms and wage rules

Correctional and detention facility clea.basis: Final clean of entire building with production cut ~40% for tool control, escorts and screening, plus ~15% government premium

Disaster response and emergency operatio.basis: Blend of final clean of entire building and data center post-construction cleaning ($0.50-1.75/sf) for communications rooms, plus ~10% for readiness and stand-down planning

Government building decommissioning clea.basis: Rough clean of entire building ($0.08-0.22/sf, 350 sf/hr) plus ~15% for hazmat-survey coordination and documentation; hauling and regulated work excluded

Government historic preservation project.basis: Final clean of entire building slowed by gentle methods, between healthcare terminal-style clean and brick and masonry cleaning ($0.40-1.20/sf), plus ~10% for preservation documentation

Government infrastructure construction c.basis: Pre-inspection jobsite clean ($0.03-0.09/sf, 900 sf/hr) slowed for equipment rooms and stormwater protection, plus ~12% for wage rules and documentation
